notes: ✦ The Studio: browse races, characters and worlds other people have shared, download them into your app, and like the ones you love. Sort by most liked, newest or most downloaded, and search.
Publish your own races, characters and worlds for everyone (free account needed to publish, like or report; browsing and downloading need no account).

Make your own races in Studio → My races: looks, biology, culture, whether they have cycles, an optional "what kind?" question (like which animal), and race lore entries. Their lore reaches the narrator whenever someone of that race is in a scene.
Race lists in the character creator and personas now use your races instead of a fixed list.
Content rules: 18+ items are hidden unless you turn them on; anything with a character under 18 can never be marked 18+; anything reported several times is hidden until reviewed.
Your own worlds no longer borrow anything from the Krampus world.
